row.desc: [Debuff]: Units affected cannot execute Mystery, Chase and non-single-target Standard Attacks. Their single-target Standard Attack instead attacks an ally unit. Lasts for 1 round.
[Debuff]: Units affected will have their Attack and Ninjutsu suppressed to 75% of their base stat. Lasts for 1 round.
[Mystery]: Heals 9 units in the ally field based on 25% of Tsunade's base Ninjutsu stat and cancels all [Debuffs], then removes all [Ignition] types from herself.

[Trigger]: Before executing her Mystery skill, Tsunade summons 3 [Small Katsuyus] based on 15% of her max [HP]. Whenever it executes Standard Attack or suffers fatal damage, heals a random ally ninja and [restores] their [Chakra Limit] to 100.
